entry.title: US Bump Key Kit
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 36.00

THE BUMP KEY KIT YOU CAN TRUST

Key "Bumping" seems like magic: insert a specially crafted key into a lock, turn the key and hit it with a hammer - and the lock opens.

While the principles of key bumping are proven, in-the-field success depends heavily on the orchestration of several elements to be effective. Crucial to performance is the percussive tool: not enough force, the key displaces the key pins, rather than communicating the inertia through to the driver pins. Too much force can damage the lock and key, and also transmit lateral shock, which hinders pin movement.

Likewise, having the right bump keys makes all the difference. Lock profiles are different in different countries; too many keys becomes time-consuming, too-few keys is frustrating.

Lab401 has removed the guesswork: the pack contains the 6 most statistically prevalent keys in North America. Each bump key is cut via CNC - not copied - ensuring each tooth has a provably identical shape for maximum performance.

Our European bump key kit is also available with the most popular EU bump key profiles.

This is the bump-key kit you can trust.

What's included

  • 1x Schlage SC1 Bump Key
  • 1x Kwikset KW1
  • 1x Weiser WR5
  • 1x Dexter DE6
  • 1x Yale Y1
  • 1x Arrow AR1

entry.title: "Under-the-door" Bypass Tool
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 55.00

RAPIDLY BYPASS ONSITE CLOSED DOORS

For on-site audits, the majority of "locked" doors faced by an auditor are actually "day-latched" - locked from the outside, but opened without a key if the inside handle is pulled down. Likewise, many other doors are locked, but "free-exit" for fire safety reasons. Even if they are locked on the outside, pulling down the inside handle instantly opens the door.

Enter the Under-The-Door Tool. Instead of trying to pick or bypass the lock mechanism, the Under-The-Door Tool slides under the door and actuates the inside door handle!

Doors can be opened in seconds without any fuss, or damage.

Compatible with almost any door with a standard "lever" handle. Works on locked doors that have a "free exit" feature. Will not work on doors with knob-style handles, or locked doors that have a separate locking mechanism.

What's included

  • 1x Under the Door Tool

Shipping Notice

This tool is over 100cm / 42 inches long. It will flat-packed, and will be shipped separately from any other items in your order. A second shipping fee will be calculated at checkout specifically for this product.

Key duplication in the field

The best way to open a lock is with its key: the Lab401 Key Molding Kit has everything you need to duplicate almost any key in a matter of seconds.

If you've got access to the original, you've got everything you need to make a new key, including the vast majority of high-security keys.

Built specifically for emergency or in-the-field duplication, the Key Molding Kit will get you through the door or give you the information you need to cut a new key later.

entry.title: Lock Bypass Kit
entry.summary:
Vendor: Lab401
Type:
Price: 110.00

YOUR BYPASS-EVERYTHING ARSENAL

Pentesters and red-teamers need to open the widest variety of locks as possible in the shortest amount of time.

While picking is an important skill to have - almost every category of locks and doors have multiple ways of bypassing the actual locking mechanism. The Lab401 Bypass Pack is a collection of tools built to rapidly bypass the majority of locks you’ll encounter on a day-to-day basis.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED, NOTHING YOU DON'T

With just six tools, no matter what situation you're in - if it can be bypassed, you're equipped: Day-latched doors, Emergency Exits, Combination Locks, Key boxes, Padlocks and more.

SPARROWS TRAVELER'S HOOK

The Sparrows Traveler's Hook bypasses outwards latched doors. Insert the high-tensile tip between the door and frame, hook the latch - and the door is open. Highly versatile - works on most door configurations.

SPARROWS QUICK DOOR SHIMS

Plastic Shims are professional version of the "credit card" trick, used to quickly open day-latched (closed but not locked) doors. Every single lock professional has at least set one of these shims. Six shims with two different thicknesses.

PADLOCK COMBS

Combing is one of the easiest techniques to bypass padlocks. Push in, push down, turn and open. Almost as quick as the original key! These are not generic combs: high-tensile thin tips allow for wide compatibility and reliable performance.

PADLOCK SHIMS

Exploiting tolerances in manufacturing, shims slide into the gap between the padlock body and the shackle, and when turned depress the locking mechanism, releasing the shackle. Four sets of different sizes to match the vast majority of padlocks - 20 pieces in total.

PADLOCK LIFTER TOOL

The Padlock Lifter exploits a weakness found in several padlocks that have only one spring-loaded bolt. The technique is incredibly simple: insert the tool as far as possible, apply a lever movement, and compatible locks will open instantly.

SPARROWS ULTRA DECODER

The Sparrows Ultra Decoder is a super-thin blade (0.2mm!) that has two uses: rapid decoding of combination-wheel locks and key boxes, and also serves as a bypass tool for many oval padlocks.

Included Tools

  • 1x Sparrows Traveler's Hook
  • 1x Sparrows Ultra Decoder
  • 1x Padlock Lifter Tool
  • 20x Padlock Shims
  • 4x Padlock Combs
  • 6x Sparrows Quick Shims

Included Accessories

  • 1x Telescopic Plastic Case
  • 1x Soft Carry Case

EXTEND YOUR LOCK BYPASS KIT

Lab401 has a range of products designed to complement the Lock Bypass Pack.

  1. Bump Key Kits: Full set of pre-cut Bump Keys for Europe and North America
  2. Molding Kit: Everything needed to reproduce keys in metal via molding.
  3. Under the Door Tool: Tool for quickly pulling down the handle on the other side of a locked or latched door.
  4. Electronic Pick Kit: If bypassing fails, we recommend this high-performance lockpick gun for rapid entry.
  5. Lockpick Kit: The "must-have" minimum lock pick tools for pentesters and red-teamers - no fluff.
  6. Cutaway re-pinnable practice cylinder: Hone your lockpicking skills, from beginner to advanced.

entry.title: FIT'D: Door Bypass Tools
entry.summary:
Vendor: RedSec
Type:
Price: 20.00

For red-teamers, "tailgating" to gain access to a secured area is high-risk: many staff have training against being followed, loitering raises suspicions, and tailgating doesn't scale: you can't wait at every door at every moment.

FIT'D solves all these problems. Small, cheap and disposable: it is quickly and discreetly adhered to door frames. When the door is opened, FIT'D prevents the door from completely closing.

Red-teamers can rapidly deploy multiple FIT'D devices at the start of an audit, and come back later to gain access.

Compatible with almost any door that opens inwards - including auto-latching doors and magnetic locks. FIT'D can be easily installed and removed without causing any damage to paint, wall or doors.

Available in two variants:

  • FIT'D: optimised to be attached to door frames.
  • LIFT'D: optimised to be attached to the door itself.

Sold in packs of 10 with multiple colours, optimised for door-frame camouflage.

What's included

  • 2x White
  • 1x Grey
  • 1x Transluscent
  • 1x Red
  • 1x Blue
  • 1x Brown
  • 1x Beige
